source.text: ወመንገለ፡ ዐረቡ፡ ለዝ፡ ካልእ፡ ደብር፡ ወይቴሐቶ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ኑሐ፡ ወቈላ፡ ታሕቱ፡ ማእከሎሙ፡ ወካልእት፡ ቈላ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ ወይቡስ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽንፈ፡ ሠለስቲሆሙ።
source.note: Selected Charles1906 printed64-66/PDF102+104. Current POB clips after ካልእ፡. Candidate restores the continuation before numbered 5 and corrects OCR ወካእእት to printed ወካልእት; exact source/English need independent scan review.

translation.text: And west of this was another mountain, lower than it and not high[a]; beneath it, between the mountains, was a valley, and another valley, deep and dry, toward the ends of all three.[b]

footnotes.text: The height or extent term is difficult; “not high” is contextual wording for the mountain, not a measurement or identification.

The selected text distinguishes a valley below and between the mountains from a second deep, dry valley toward the extremity of the three. The precise spatial arrangement is not a modern geographical identification.
